questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must obey. It means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are in or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in the direction you are heading.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Watch for people when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to conditions ahead on or near the road. They are usually diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Get ready to stop or slow down for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used instead of mechanical turn signals. When an operator extends their left arm straight out to the side, they are signaling that they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is coming up. Be careful and watch for people crossing the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Be prepared for other vehicles to join your road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is unsafe to enter this road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed limit for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards or road conditions. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that you are approaching a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road makes a sharp turn to the right and then a sharp turn to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards or road conditions. This sign warns you that cyclists may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and increase your distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used by motorcycle groups to communicate while riding. When a lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, it signals the group to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you not to enter because traffic flows in the opposite direction. Do not use this entrance on one-way streets or expressway ramps.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used by motorcycle groups to communicate while riding. When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm facing down and swings it down to their side, it signals the group to slow down.
